title: Course project
reading: Administrative slide describing the course project. Projects may be on any interesting topic related to AI and agents, either theory or applications, done in teams of 2 to 3 students, with examples available from CSCE 625 Artificial Intelligence (Spring 2026). Links are given to a shared Google Slides presentation deck and a Google Sheets team sign-up spreadsheet. Teams must sign up by 11:59 pm today (Wednesday), highlighted in red, and the presentation order will be decided tomorrow.

concepts.name: Course project logistics
concepts.why_it_matters: Sets team size, topic scope, and the sign-up deadline students must meet.
